component.name: ZaDark
component.summary: Dark theme and privacy extension for Zalo

description.p: ZaDark is an extension for Zalo providing a modern dark interface and privacy controls.

ul.li: Modern dark theme for main windows, chat views, and popup viewers.
Privacy controls: prevent sending 'typing' and 'seen' indicators.

description.p: ZaDark 26.3 with support for Zalo PC 26.10+, improved reaction bar, and style persistence.
